children: Japanese stocks are higher, supported by bargain-hunting, as recent rising momentum in crude oil eases. Pharmaceutical and machinery stocks are leading gains. Eisai is up 2.4% and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries is 3.2% higher. The dollar is at 155.87 yen, up from Y155.10 as of Wednesday's Tokyo stock market close, following the Fed's rate increase overnight. Investors are focusing on bond yields and crude oil prices. The Nikkei Stock Average is up 1.0% at 64548.75. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
